source.test: createSlot(name:for:...) reused for Phase 6 reconciliation State 1 (live folders only) — see docs/msc2/worlds/phase6-scope.md §"State 1 — live folders only"

expected.new_slot_source: archived from the current live folders, mirroring createInitialWorldSlotIfNeeded's own archive step

notes: phase6-scope.md State 1 (lines 50-52): no world_slots/ directory, or one present but resolving to no active slot at all (see resolved-active-empty-slots-returns-nil.json / State 6 of this domain). There is nothing recorded to reconcile against, so Phase 6 archives the current live folders into a brand-new slot and persists that slot as active -- the exact same operation MSC 1's own post-first-stop bootstrap performs (world-slots/initial-slot-bootstrap-creates-and-activates.json), just triggered at Phase 6 startup instead of after a stop event. The live folders themselves are left untouched on disk; the new slot is a parallel archived copy. No recovery snapshot is needed because there is only one source of truth here and it isn't at risk of being silently overwritten.
